claim_boundary: C017 contains two decisive attacks, exact constructive audits, and narrowing attacks. Survival or formalization is not evidence of truth.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: fixed local gadget amplification may already have a polynomial proof because DAG sharing is reusable
attacks.method: Prove A equivalent B once, propagate equivalence bottom-up with constant-cost congruence per context gate, and apply R038 to obtain a polynomial rewrite chain.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: equal local type inventories may not determine global low-treewidth dynamic-program behavior
attacks.method: Construct exact radius-R SAT/UNSAT XOR-cycle twins of treewidth two; the identity compiler preserves local ancestry while a global cycle-parity DP returns opposite correct answers.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a fixed equivalent gadget pair may lack a bounded proof
attacks.method: Use completeness of the fixed Frege basis; the constant circuits have one fixed finite proof independent of n.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: exponentially many unfolded occurrences may force exponentially many congruence steps
attacks.method: Charge one derivation per unique DAG gate and reproduce a depth-24 shared tower with exponential unfolding but linear proof accounting.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a polynomial Circuit-Frege proof may not imply a polynomial chain in the exact relation
attacks.method: Apply the exact R038 theorem to the constructed proof; record the unknown exponent without changing polynomiality.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the composition operator may hide a non-circuit global transformation
attacks.method: Restrict H117 to ordinary acyclic Boolean circuit contexts with explicit ports; operations outside that syntax remain excluded.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the claimed SAT and UNSAT labels may be wrong
attacks.method: Propagate one variable value around each equality/inequality cycle and check consistency exactly by parity.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the formulas may be only statistically or Weisfeiler-Leman similar
attacks.method: Canonicalize every rooted signed induced incidence ball by exact individualization-refinement and compare complete multisets for radii zero through four.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: larger radii may see both inequality gadgets in one SAT component
attacks.method: Choose cycle length 8R+12 and prove every radius-R incidence ball meets at most one marked edge, making distribution among components locally invisible.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the clause encoding may create hidden primal chords
attacks.method: Deduplicate variable pairs from every binary clause and verify the primal graph is exactly two cycles.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a local twin pair of low input treewidth is defeated by the identity compiler
attacks.method: Require superlogarithmic or otherwise certified high input treewidth so identity is outside the promised low-treewidth output class.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a constant-pass transduction may break the proposed common covering relation
attacks.method: Demand an exact lift-equivariance theorem for every output symbol, edge, and recovery annotation; no proof is currently registered.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a low-treewidth output lift may retain global parity without factoring through the base quotient
attacks.method: Identify quotient factorization as a separate theorem rather than infer it from local neighborhoods.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: component identifiers or output assembly may transmit lift parity through legal local pieces
attacks.method: Require every such channel to appear in the transduction relation and be covered by the factorization proof; this remains open.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the witness-union circuit may accept an unsatisfiable formula
attacks.method: Every accepting disjunct explicitly supplies a hardwired satisfying assignment, so acceptance implies satisfiability.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the sound circuit may miss a listed positive formula
attacks.method: Include every distinct listed witness as a disjunct and replay the finite fixture.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: fixed-assignment CNF evaluation may hide SAT search or superpolynomial parsing
attacks.method: Use a padded fixed-shape encoding and a direct literal-selection, clause-OR, formula-AND circuit with polynomial gate count.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a much smaller sound circuit may cover the list without representing its witnesses separately
attacks.method: Record witness diversity as necessary but not sufficient; no lower bound against all semantic compressions is claimed.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the chosen endpoints may have a polynomial compositional proof before any potential is considered
attacks.method: Use H117 to exclude every fixed EF-easy gadget context from the endpoint search.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: exact opposite-label local twins may not exist
attacks.method: H118 supplies an explicit 2-CNF family, but its low treewidth shows the construction clause alone does not imply the compiler obstruction clause.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a positive list may be accepted by a small globally SAT-sound circuit built from its witnesses
attacks.method: Construct H120 and charge distinct witness evaluators against the n^k budget.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: identical bounded-radius input views may be treated as a complete obstruction
attacks.method: The H118 identity compiler shows global low-treewidth assembly can preserve parity even when every local signature agrees.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the seven-gate summary may be mistaken for arbitrary edit distance
attacks.method: Use R038's Boolean-algebra local replacement relation and its proof-to-chain theorem, not a generic gate insertion metric.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: certified positive errors may be covered by a union of hardwired assignments
attacks.method: Apply H120 to any positive subset and retain the need for negative evidence or incompressible witness diversity.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: local pseudoexpectation transport may be assumed to determine the global output graph
attacks.method: Separate local moment consistency from connected-component and quotient assembly, as exposed by H118.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the identity compiler survives every low-treewidth local twin family
attacks.method: Route the surviving target through H119, which explicitly requires high input treewidth and common-quotient output factorization.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the polynomial output exponent may conceal a list larger than the target circuit budget
attacks.method: Require the list, formula encoding, and distinct witness count to be compared explicitly with the same n^k parameter through H120.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: transparent equivalence may itself provide the short proof that defeats the desired distance lower bound
attacks.method: After H111's death, require endpoints whose equivalence is explicit mathematically but not generated by a polynomial compositional Circuit-Frege derivation.
